company.description: Abel takes police body camera footage and turns it into completed police reports. Currently American patrol officers tend to spend one third of their shift writing reports - turning that to zero would increase the effective police force by 50%, radically changing US cities.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based system that converts body camera footage into detailed police reports by analyzing video, transcription, and related data.
